title: What a CAGE 4 Score Measures: An Audit of a Learned Cyber-Defense Benchmark, Its Reference Defenders, and the Tables Built on Them
abstract: arXiv:2611.14068v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: CAGE Challenge 4 is the benchmark on which learned multi-agent cyber defenders are compared. We reproduce its two reference defenders, KEEP and H-MARL Expert, in a pinned container and show that three things read from it measure less than they are taken to measure. First, the simulator silently discards any action asserted for an agent whose previous action is still running, and charges one point for a discarded Restore as for one that runs. The documented observation does not expose the busy flag. Both reference defenders read it in their own wrappers, and switching that check off at evaluation costs KEEP's released policy 99.58 points per episode and H-MARL's 145.98, in both cases the charge for Restores sent to busy agents, with H-MARL's executed actions unchanged step for step. translated_title: CAGE 4 分数究竟衡量了什么：对一个学习型网络防御基准、其参考防御者及基于它们构建的排行表的审计
translated_abstract: CAGE Challenge 4 是用于比较学习型多智能体网络防御者的基准。我们在固定容器环境中复现了它的两个参考防御者 KEEP 和 H-MARL Expert，并表明从该基准中读取的三个量所衡量的内容少于人们所认为的。首先，当某个智能体的上一个动作仍在执行时，模拟器会静默丢弃为该智能体断言的任何动作，并且对被丢弃的 Restore 与实际执行的 Restore 收取相同的一分代价。文档所描述的观测中并不暴露“忙碌”标志。两个参考防御者都在各自的封装中自行读取该标志，而在评估时关闭该检查会使 KEEP 已发布的策略每回合损失 99.58 分、H-MARL 损失 145.98 分——两种情况下，扣分均来自发送给忙碌智能体的 Restore，而 H-MARL 实际执行的动作逐步保持完全不变。在一个监督式测试框架上，将干预延迟到智能体空闲时才执行，在已公布的设置下每回合价值 25.3 分和 27.6 分。在训练中……
tldr: 该论文审计了 CAGE Challenge 4 网络防御基准，发现其模拟器会静默丢弃发往忙碌智能体的动作并照常计分，而两个参考防御者均依赖文档未披露的“忙碌”标志检查，修正这些问题后已发布分数每回合变动高达约 146 分，表明基于该基准的排行表所测量的内容远少于其表面所示。
en_tdlr: This paper audits the CAGE Challenge 4 cyber-defense benchmark, showing that its simulator silently discards actions sent to busy agents while charging for them, and that both reference defenders rely on an undocumented busy-flag check—correcting these issues shifts published scores by up to 145.98 points per episode, revealing that the built tables measure less than they appear to.
